description: Get one contact (Kontakt) by its sevDesk id, with its postal addresses (Adressen, e.g. Rechnungsanschrift) and communication ways (email, phone, website). Use it after sevdesk_contacts_search to check a customer's (Kunde) or supplier's (Lieferant) details, e.g. the billing address or invoice email, before working with their documents. ISO country codes are included when the country table resolves the ids.
name: sevdesk_contact_get
title: Get a sevDesk contact
